<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/v3/error/subscription"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Searches only the subscription identified by the current subscription header. Results are newest first.
When from and to are omitted, all retained persisted errors are included. An empty errors collection returns 200, not 404.
Use skip, size, and hasNextPage to iterate through results.
